claim.claim-text: 1. A battery pack (120), comprising:

a unit module stack formed by stacking a plurality of unit modules (121A), each unit module (121A) having a plurality of battery cells (121) stacked on each other; a swelling absorption pad (126) interposed between the unit modules (121A) adjacent to each other; and a pack housing (123) configured to accommodate the unit module stack and the swelling absorption pad (126), wherein the swelling absorption pad (126) has a coolant channel (P) formed to extend along a longitudinal direction thereof.
2. The battery pack (120) according to claim 1, wherein the coolant channel (P) includes:

3. The battery pack according to claim 1, wherein the coolant channel (P) is open such that a coolant flowing through the coolant channel (P) directly contacts a pair of battery cells (121) in contact with the swelling absorption pad (126).
4. The battery pack (120) according to claim 2, wherein the input port (126a) is located higher than the output port (126b).
5. The battery pack (120) according to claim 1, wherein the battery pack (120) includes:

an air inlet (124) formed through the pack housing (123) at one side of the unit module stack in a stacking direction; and an air outlet (125) formed through the pack housing (123) at the other side of the unit module stack in the stacking direction.

6. The battery pack (120) according to claim 5, wherein the battery pack (120) includes an expansion pad (127) disposed inside the air inlet (124) and the air outlet (125) and configured to expand due to the contact with a coolant introduced into the battery pack (120) to close the air inlet (124) and the air outlet (125).

7. The battery pack (120) according to claim 6, wherein the battery pack (120) includes a pair of bus bar frames (122) respectively coupled to one side and the other side of the unit module stack in a width direction.

8. The battery pack (120) according to claim 7, wherein the air inlet (124) and the air outlet (125) are formed at locations corresponding an empty space formed between the bus bar frame (122) and the pack housing (123).

9. The battery pack (120) according to claim 7, wherein the battery pack (120) includes a coolant tube insert hole (123a) formed through the pack housing (123) from one side or the other side of the unit module stack in the stacking direction to communicate with an empty space formed between the bus bar frame (122) and the pack housing (123).
10. A battery rack (100), comprising:

a unit module stack formed by stacking a plurality of unit modules (121A), each unit module (121A) having a plurality of battery cells (121) stacked on each other; a swelling absorption pad (126) interposed between the unit modules (121A) adjacent to each other; and a pack housing (123) configured to accommodate the unit module stack and the swelling absorption pad (126), wherein the swelling absorption pad (126) has a coolant channel (P) formed to extend along a longitudinal direction thereof, wherein the battery pack (120) includes:
11. The battery rack (100) according to claim 10,

wherein the battery rack (100) includes a plurality of valves (170) installed in the coolant tube (150), and the plurality of valves (170) are respectively installed adjacent to the plurality of battery packs (120) of the module stack to individually allow or block the flow of coolant introduced into the plurality of battery packs (120).
12. The battery rack (100) according to claim 10, wherein the battery pack (120) includes:

a unit module stack formed by stacking a plurality of unit modules (121A), each unit module (121A) having a plurality of battery cells (121) stacked on each other; a swelling absorption pad (126) interposed between the unit modules (121A) adjacent to each other; and a pack housing (123) configured to accommodate the unit module stack and the swelling absorption pad (126), wherein the swelling absorption pad (126) has a coolant channel (P) formed to extend along a longitudinal direction thereof.
13. The battery rack (100) according to claim 12, wherein the coolant channel (P) includes:

14. The battery rack (100) according to claim 12, wherein the coolant channel (P) has an opened shape such that a coolant flowing through the coolant channel (P) directly contacts a pair of battery cells (121) in contact with the swelling absorption pad (126).
15. An energy storage system (ESS), comprising a plurality of battery racks (100) according to any one of claims 1 to 9.
